title: THUNDERBOLT 2.0 03M MOBULIDAE DEVIL FISH
summary: This package is technically you are buying a pet and getting a body as a gift lol the amount of engineering and details they put into that monster is tremendous. For a price of $30, it's obviously a steal.
body: This package is technically you are buying a pet and getting a body as a gift lol the amount of engineering and details they put into that monster is tremendous. For a price of $30, it's obviously a steal.

Thunderbolt 03M is not much different from the previous Thunderbolt 02A. The inner frame is 80-90% identical with slight changes in the shoulders, and legs. You can swap most of the part with each other with no problems though I would not recommend it. The 03M has better colour scheme to my taste. The outer armour sees lots of changes. Especially, the water decals come with 03M are generous and at high quality. The details they add to the model kit makes day and night differences. I chose the pink pieces yet you can always use the black equivalent they provide.

The stingray. It's beautiful. From the inside out. Every nook and cranny. There are parts that hide inside layers of armour yet they still put the effort to design them properly. For the package of $30, I would say $10 on the Thunderbolt and its gun whilst the rest of the money on the stingray and that trident. It's truly amazing to build. The experience is quite smooth.
The base comes with 3 pictures for you to put on display.

The problems? It has a few. The joints are tough. Be careful putting them together and make sure you have tools to fix them. Don't try to push it when you feel it's difficult. Check the manual, fix them a bit with your blade. Try again. The arms and legs joints need attention to be perfect. You don't have to sweat it but don't rush it.
I would recommend this Thunderbolt 03M over Fire Lord or Star Fall, since they are at the same price.
Music: Han Zimmer feat. Alan Walker - Time (Extended version)
